svg.title: Ila reads Vale's conclusion while Cecil listens.
svg.desc: Ila holds her spectacles and reads from the report's clean blank conclusion area. Cecil remains perfectly still beside her as she says that Golmohar Junction remains noncompliant with several fundamental assumptions.

text.tspan: Ila reads Vale's final conclusion exactly.
